title: Những ứng cử viên hàng đầu cho Chiếc giày vàng World Cup 2026

scenes.subjectHint: Chiếc giày vàng World Cup bên cạnh Mbappe, Haaland và Messi
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 football poster artwork featuring the Golden Boot trophy glowing in gold in the center. Kylian Mbappe in the blue French kit, Erling Haaland in the red Norwegian kit, and Lionel Messi in the blue-and-white Argentine kit are shown behind it in intense, determined poses. Background: a dynamic gold and black graphic design with a giant faint World Cup 2026 logo watermark, dramatic golden light rays radiating outwards. Saturated palette, high contrast, glossy finish, sports promotional poster style. No on-image text.
